content: Pin LHM v0.9.6 (latest stable Feb 2026). GitHub release assets include LibreHardwareMonitor-net472.zip with LibreHardwareMonitorLib.dll + HidSharp.dll + dependencies. NuGet package LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6 also available. fetch-lhm.ps1 should download release zip, extract DLLs to vendor/LibreHardwareMonitor/. x64-only in NuGet after 0.9.5.
